About this Event

Tapped In Yoga at Forest City Brewery
Join us for Tapped In, a grounding yoga experience designed to help you slow down, reconnect, and reset. Through gentle, breath-led movement and intentional pacing, you’ll leave feeling more balanced, centered, and at ease.

For the summer season, classes will be held outdoors in the beer garden, offering a relaxed and welcoming space to move and unwind in community. In the event of rain, class will be moved indoors to the beer hall. Please bring a yoga mat, water, layers + a friend! All levels welcome.

Expect:
• Foundational alignment
• Mindful sequencing
• Breath awareness woven throughout
• Intentional movement without rushing
• A calm, grounded atmosphere

This is not a fast-paced power class. This is a slow-flow, basics inspired yoga session.

After class, you're welcome to enjoy the welcoming brewery atmosphere. Craft beverages, cocktails, NA options and tasty, hearty food are available.

Please bring a yoga mat, water, layers + a friend! All levels welcome.
